mutation_semantics: Replaces the entire Next_Rule lookup with a full scan of Value.Array_Rules from its first element for each stroke; increments Seen only for matching Boundary and selects the Rule_Index-th matching boundary rule.
polls_retained: Poll (Thickness) runs once for every Array_Rules element visited by each rescan; validation and Rules_At polls are unchanged.
quadratic_claim: Not made for mutant4; mutant5 faithfully restarts traversal for each generated rule stroke. Observed large-N counts are consistent with the intended repeated-scan behavior.
